name: Kalrav AI Agent
author: irisideatechsolutions

sections.description:
• Interactive Chat Interface – A modern, fully customizable chat window that integrates beautifully with your website’s layout and style.

  • Quick & Easy Setup – Simply install, activate, and start chatting — your AI assistant is ready within minutes, no coding needed.

  • Intelligent Conversations – Engage visitors with fast, natural, and context-aware responses powered by advanced AI technology.

  • Flexible Customization – Personalize Common questions, icons, and greetings to perfectly reflect Kalrav Ai identity.

  • Smart Engagement Triggers – Automatically welcome visitors, collect leads, or reply to common questions with ease.

  • Lightweight & Secure – Built for speed, stability, and privacy, ensuring smooth performance across all devices.

External Services

This plugin supports integration with external services (such as AWS) to enhance chatbot functionality, including generating or retrieving images as part of chatbot responses.
User questions and session information are sent securely to this API during Kalrav AI interactions.

The external service used:

  • Service Name: Kalrav AI
  • Purpose: To process and respond to user messages in the chat widget.
  • Data Sent: User message, session ID (anonymous), and site identifier.

  • Data Received: AI-generated response content.
    Please check our privacy policy and terms of services:

    Privacy policy : https://kalrav.ai/privacy-policy/
    Terms Of service : https://kalrav.ai/terms-of-services/

No personal data is stored or shared with third parties.

License

GPLv2 or later. See license.txt.
sections.installation:
1. Upload kalrav-ai-agent folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen (Plugins > Installed Plugins).

You will find Kalrav Ai settings in your WordPress admin screen.

For basic usage, have a look at the plugin’s website.
sections.faq:
What is Kalrav AI Agent?

Kalrav AI Agent is a powerful, customizable AI plugin that adds a floating chat widget to your WordPress site, enabling real-time AI-powered conversations to help visitors get quick answers and engage with your services.

How does Kalrav AI Agent improve user engagement?

By providing instant, intelligent responses via the kalrav, Kalrav AI Agent helps visitors find information faster, discover relevant content, and interact with your website more effectively.

Can I customize the chat widget’s appearance?

Yes, you can customize the chat widget’s look and feel by overriding the default CSS or adding custom styles targeting the widget’s elements.

Is Kalrav AI Agent compatible with all WordPress themes?

Kalrav AI Agent is designed to work smoothly with most WordPress themes. However, some themes with custom scripts or styles may require minor adjustments for optimal display.

Does Kalrav AI Agent collect user data?

Kalrav AI Agent processes user interactions in real-time to provide responses but does not store personal data unless explicitly enabled through plugin settings.
